page.layout: One printed page, one text column at the right of the scan, with the running head at the top. Above the text, a centred arithmetic display of symbols (not text, shown as a block of lines). Below it, the running text in paragraphs. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Quidam scire cupit quot Thaleros faciant albi 3 6 4. Thalerus Marpurgensis valet albis triginta uno. Colloco sic:

Et dico 3 in 3 continetur semel, & unum in semicirculo noto. Per ı autem nō multiplico, sed statim subtraho, inquiens, 3 à 3 remanet nihil, ı à 6 remanent 5, quæ suprà noto. Deinde transfero Divisores, dicens: 3 in 5 continenturı, & ı in semicirculo noto: ac omissa multiplicatione, statim subtraho 3 à 5 remanent 2, ı à 4 remanent 3. Albi igitur 3 6 4 faciunt ıı Thaleros, & viginti tres albos.

page.notes: The arithmetic display at the top and the figures in the lower display are symbolic notation of the period (crossed and marked numerals, "(" as a division sign); transcribed as printed as far as legible. Several symbols in the displays are doubtful and are not certain. The bottom display has a hand-like flourish drawn above it; this is a printed woodcut ornament, not text. The line "Probatio" at the foot is a heading-like italic word, left as a paragraph. Right edge is partly cut off in the scan; the final word of some lines may be incomplete.
